description: Move roles to new hierarchy positions in one call. Higher positions sit higher in the list and outrank lower ones. Moving a role that can ban, kick, time out, rename, or change roles above a role it was below lets its holders do that to the people with the other role, so that needs confirming: the first call changes nothing and returns a preview and a confirm_token, and repeating the call with the token makes the change.

confirm_token.description: The token from this exact action's preview. Where the app can show a confirmation dialog, calling with it asks the user there, and it happens only if they agree.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

moves.description: The moves: each a role by name or ID and its new position. Higher numbers rank higher.

name: reorder_roles
title: Reorder roles
